<function name="GetBitsPerSample" parent="IGModAudioChannel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Retrieves the number of bits per sample of the sound channel.

Doesn't work for mp3 and ogg files.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Number of bits per sample, or 0 if unknown.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
